Exact Answer: After Queen Victoria left Buckingham Palace following her husband's death in 1861, the palace was seldom used and neglected; a note appeared on its fence in 1864 suggesting it be let or sold due to the occupant's "declining business," and it remained shuttered for most of the year while court functions moved to Windsor Castle.
